root_cause: The Radios component only updates ARIA attributes and conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven changes (arrow keys).
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener that invokes the same update logic as the click handler, ensuring ARIA attributes and visibility are updated for all radios when selection changes via any interaction.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation will now correctly show/hide conditional fields when selecting different radio options, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order), and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Potential duplicate updates when both click and change fire for mouse interactions (idempotent).
Possible interference with other custom change handlers if present.
verification_requirements: Verify arrow key navigation between radios correctly hides/shows associated conditionals.
Verify mouse click selection continues to work as before.
Verify form data reflects the selected radio value.
Verify ARIA attributes aria-expanded and visibility of conditional elements update appropriately.
